description: Verifies the 2026-09-26 CHGDTAARA/*LDA redesign of the two Part 5 QCMDEXC teaching files (src/legacy/qrpgsrc/za0510.rpg, 05-04; solutions/05-13/za0500-ticket3.rpg, 05-13), neither yet hardware-confirmed (see docs/probes.md's 'Part 5 QCMDEXC teaching material redesign' section). ZA0510's own *PSSR only fires when a LOKUP against the compile-time TABPCD table misses (05-04's own exercise 7 forces this by corrupting TABPCD's last entry). Rather than hand-editing (and having to hand-revert) the real lesson source during an unattended batch, this manifest compiles a verification-only variant, verify/part05-qcmdexc-runtime/src/za0510v.rpg, under a distinct object name ZA0510V - byte-for-byte identical to za0510.rpg except TABPCD's last entry ('P00006' -> 'P09999', exactly exercise 7's own instruction), so real ZAIKOM data (untouched) forces exactly one LOKUP miss and drives the *PSSR/QCMDEXC/CHGDTAARA path deterministically. *LDA is job-scoped: a `collect` step (db2 via qsh) runs in a separate job after the connection ends and would only see blanks, so verify/part05-qcmdexc-runtime/src/vlda.clp (a tiny CL helper, CALLed as an ordinary step in this SAME wrapper job/call stack) reads *LDA back with RTVDTAARA and reports it via SNDPGMMSG - captured automatically into VFYLOG by the wrapper's own insertLog mechanism (verify/lib/clgen.mjs), regardless of which of RUNZA1V/RUNVLDA's own per-step MONMSG fired. RPG/400 Reference (work/design/refs/rpg400ref.txt lines 1840-1841, 3096) describes ENDSR '*CANCL' as a controlled program cancellation (closes files, unlocks data areas) - NOT confirmed here whether this raises any escape message back to the CALLing CL wrapper, hence RUNZA1V's broad MONMSG below is a safety net, not an expected-failure assertion; judge success by VLDA's reported *LDA(1,20) value ('ZA0510 ERROR' + 8 trailing blanks expected), not by whether RUNZA1V's own step is marked FAILED. za0500-ticket3.rpg (05-13) is compiled here ONLY (V1, under the distinct object name ZA0500T3 so it never overwrites the as-shipped ZA0500) - its own *PSSR runtime path additionally needs the JU0900C call chain plus a bad-data injection (05-11's technique) to reach, which is deferred to a future connection/manifest (P2/2F) rather than folded into this one. Prerequisite: TXSETUP has already built the sample DB (ZAIKOM/JUCHUD/JUCHUM) in this library, same prerequisite as part05-legacy-probe - run from draft/part06 (or any branch with this merge), not main.
